_comment: The FIRST real DeepSpeed config in topic 8. Labs 1 to 5 carry none,
correctly: a ~14k-parameter policy has nothing for ZeRO to shard.
This lab's largest model is 705M parameters -- 11.3 GB of weights and
Adam state before a single activation -- so the question is live.
NOTE WHAT IS ABSENT: there is no "optimizer" block. Naming one makes
DeepSpeed build its own FUSED Adam and JIT-compile it with nvcc, and
the PyPI CUDA wheels ship ptxas rather than nvcc. The compile dies
with 'CUDA_HOME environment variable is not set', which reads like a
misconfiguration and is really a missing toolchain. train_dyn.py hands
in a torch optimiser instead, which keeps ZeRO's partitioning and
skips the kernel build. Same lesson the repo carries for
train_batch_size is deliberately OMITTED so any --num_gpus works.
DeepSpeed asserts train_batch_size == micro x accum x world_size at
startup, and hardcoding it pins the GPU count.
